content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a fully functional digital storefront using the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH. These stacks are designed specifically for creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, where payment platforms are restricted. By leveraging free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and integrating with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, you can launch your store without needing a traditional server or payment processor. This approach ensures that you retain full ownership of your data and digital products, paving the way for immediate operational capabilities.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To get started with minimal investment, the Sovereign Starter Stack is your best option. Priced at $97, it includes everything you need to deploy a digital storefront in just 48 hours. This stack utilizes Google Apps Script for backend logic and NOWPayments for processing over 300 cryptocurrencies. You'll be able to load three products and receive 30 days of support as you get accustomed to this new infrastructure. The simplicity of this setup allows you to focus on creating and selling your products without the overhead of complex server infrastructure or reliance on traditional payment systems.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

As you embark on building your digital storefront, it's critical to focus on what truly matters. Skip unnecessary steps like complex website customization or extensive marketing plans at this stage. Concentrate on deploying your payment solution and ensuring your products are ready for sale. You can refine your storefront's appearance and expand your marketing efforts later once you have a functioning system in place. Getting your payment processing live is the priority, as it enables you to start generating revenue immediately while you work on other aspects of your business.
No server required — deploy your digital storefront in just 48 hours.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To facilitate your first transaction, follow these steps: deploy your chosen stack, configure your NOWPayments account, and list your digital products. Once your store is live, share the URL with your network and promote it through social media channels. Monitor your transactions closely through the NOWPayments dashboard to ensure everything is functioning smoothly. Remember, USDT on Tron allows you to receive payments with low fees and rapid confirmation times, making it an ideal choice for your initial transactions. This approach will quickly validate your setup and provide critical feedback for adjustments.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, you should finalize your product offerings and ensure your payment infrastructure is operational. Set up your digital storefront by deploying the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Once deployed, conduct a test transaction to verify that everything is functioning correctly. Start reaching out to potential customers through your existing networks, informing them of your digital products and how they can purchase them using cryptocurrency. This proactive approach will help you kickstart your sales and gain momentum in your digital commerce journey.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Retain full ownership of your data and digital products — no subscriptions.

For those looking to streamline their digital sales, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for instant access to the Complete Builder Kit.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
